'''Stein''' is a male Lollo Logistic NPC found talking with his co-worker, '''Gallo''' at the entrance of Startorch Academy during the day.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Gallo:''' Every shipment into Lahai-Roi is a nightmare...

:'''Stein:''' Back in the pre-Lament era, cargo planes would only take a few hours.

:'''Gallo:''' Right?! I can only imagine the time before the Etheric Sea covered Solaris. Now we can only rely on high-speed ships...

:'''Stein:''' No wonder [[Triumph Avionics]] and [[Panovista Transit]] are getting all the hype at the New Federation [[World Expo]].

:'''Gallo:''' Frankly speaking, flight isn't totally banned, but only a handful of companies are licensed, and launch protocols are strict. Not to mention, no insurer wants to cover them.

:'''Stein:''' If only I were a flying-type Resonator, then licenses wouldn't matter at all...
{{Dialogue End}}
